title: Jain Friendly Syrian Epoisses Tagine
description: A briny and flavorful Syrian dish featuring Epoisses cheese, slow-cooked to perfection in a tagine, made Jain-friendly by using vegetarian ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the crumbly Epoisses cheese and cook until it is melted and well combined with the onions and garlic.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
Reheat the tagine gently over low heat before serving.
